source.candidate: working tree at same HEAD; no commit/push/branch operation
source.baselineMethod: git archive HEAD; isolated source and Cargo target; hu-postflop source unchanged

environment.load: Other computations active; uncontrolled PC load. Reference timings only.

design.rationale: Storage elements are a conservative work proxy; require two large children, never fan out in one-thread pools. Same rule in CFR and value passes, independent of chance budget. No claim of optimal threshold on GCP c2d.
design.floatingPoint: Action/chance folds and normalization sums keep original ordering; f64 division retained.
design.scratch: Flat scratch output per parallel chance/action visit; worker-local reentrant scratch lease. Row/view metadata still allocates and scratch first-use growth can allocate.

commands.baseline: Same Cargo command with --manifest-path runs/p1-perf/base/Cargo.toml; CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/p1-t2-base.
commands.pairedRiver: Same parameters, 5 sequential pairs per thread count, invoking already-built executables directly.
commands.cpuSupplement: Direct executable, threads=1, evals=0; Turn warmup=1 iters=5, River warmup=5 iters=500; 2 sequential pairs. TotalProcessorTime includes preparation/build/warmup/CFR and is an auxiliary metric.
